testName: OmniScript Guided Multi-Step Customer Intake & Address Change
steps:
1. Launch OmniScript "Customer_ChangeOfAddress_English"
2. In Step 1 (Identity Verification), enter Account Number "ACC-10492" and Billing Postal Code
3. Click "Next" button
4. In Step 2 (New Address), enter New Street "450 Market St" and select State "CA"
5. Verify real-time Google Maps / Postal validation normalizes address to "450 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94105"
6. In Step 3 (Review & Confirm), review summary card
7. Click "Submit" button
8. Verify success step displays confirmation badge
9. Open target Account in CRM and verify Billing Address updated cleanly via DataRaptor Load
